title.en: Diesel 30 Concrete Pump is a catalogue comparison, not a page from Vertical and horizontal
title.zh: 柴油30型混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印是目录对照，不是「水平與垂直」那一页

description.en: Diesel 30 Concrete Pump. 60 m stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Vertical and horizontal.
description.zh: 柴油30型混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印。60 m仍在目录格子里。插图来自「水平與垂直」。

h1.en: Diesel 30 Concrete Pump is a catalogue comparison, not a page from Vertical and horizontal
h1.zh: 柴油30型混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印是目录对照，不是「水平與垂直」那一页

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Pumping Distance (H / V) is 60 m / 180 m. Read each label with its own figure. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vertical_and_horizontal.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油30型混凝土泵的距离文字写成：输送距离（水平/垂直）是60 m / 180 m。同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有写出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vertical_and_horizontal。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vertical_and_horizontal. Subject: Horizontal (PSF). Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Pumping Distance (H / V) is 60 m / 180 m. Pumping Distance (H / V) is 60 m / 180 m. Maximum aggregate size is 3 cm and below. If a distance entry is missing on the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump sheet, it stays missing.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vertical_and_horizontal。画面主体：Horizontal (PSF)。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油30型混凝土泵的距离文字写成：输送距离（水平/垂直）是60 m / 180 m。管路沿程要克服摩擦，水平段和垂直升高不是同一项工作。理论输送量是15 m³/h，最大出口压力是20 MPa。

body.en: Read each label with its own figure. A pipeline loses pressure to friction, so a horizontal run and a vertical rise are different duties. Main-unit weight is 2000 kg. Theoretical Output is 15 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 20 MPa.
body.zh: 同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有写出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。最大骨料粒径 3 cm and below。

body.en: Horizontal and vertical are not interchangeable when both appear, and a missing vertical entry is not filled from another model. The sheet already separates them when it lists both. Subject: Shotcrete Covered Cliff Auckland. Neither entry is a metre.
body.zh: 画面「Shotcrete」的主体是喷射混凝土 Covered Cliff Auckland，不能代替这些格子。主体：喷射混凝土 Covered Cliff Auckland。

body.en: The frame “Shotcrete” shows Shotcrete Covered Cliff Auckland and does not replace these entries. Hopper capacity is 0.3 m³. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not read a metre figure off that frame. Do not paste another manufacturer's boom length onto Diesel 30 Concrete Pump.
body.zh: 输送距离（水平/垂直）是60 m / 180 m。柴油30型混凝土泵这一页如果少了某一距离格，就让它继续空着。

question.en: Which distance text does Diesel 30 Concrete Pump list?
question.zh: 柴油30型混凝土泵标出了哪几句距离？

answer.en: Pumping Distance (H / V) is 60 m / 180 m. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vertical_and_horizontal.
answer.zh: 输送距离（水平/垂直）是60 m / 180 m。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vertical_and_horizontal画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can horizontal and vertical be swapped?
question.zh: 水平和垂直可以对调吗？

answer.en: Only when the label itself puts them in that order. Keep the shown order. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vertical_and_horizontal.
answer.zh: 只有标题本身写成那个顺序时才按那个顺序。保留写出来的次序。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vertical_and_horizontal画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 15 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vertical_and_horizontal.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是15 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vertical_and_horizontal画面里印出的数字。
